answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one lotus weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 226 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 249 times the capital for one share. The umber report publishes the merge explicitly at each vault. A farm of 3049 identities would post 1935 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
